Exact symbolic and direct Jacobian checker reproduced these identities. Critical equality and nonlinear global claims excluded.

originality.rationale: Section 3.4 of Yuan–Sun–Yuan (arXiv:2610.19944v1) specifies ambient EMA followed by projection; Section 4.4 proves a conditional sufficient convergence estimate, not an ambient-extension-gauge stability frontier. The primary HTML sections on ambient EMA, its convergence analysis, tangent-space comparisons and Appendix B were inspected. Related published-finding corpus records concern equivariance of preconditioners, standard EMA cycles, or accumulator-state stability; none states or implies the identical-restriction normal-gradient threshold. General Riemannian momentum literature remains a residual historical-priority uncertainty.
residual_risks: Prior general extrinsic EMA gauge-invariance or stability literature may establish the same bound in another notation.

value.rationale: The intrinsic objective, strict minimizer and intrinsic Hessian are independent of c, but the ambient-memory iteration has an exact opposing-stability phase transition controlled solely by the normal gradient. This exposes a structural implementation sensitivity and sharp spectral benchmark for choosing and comparing extrinsic vs tangent-space momentum, beyond a routine parameter substitution.
